bias.calibration_note: T26 affine calibration on the lens readout only (z = unembed(transport(h_l)) / temp * logit_scale + logit_bias); the model's own logits are never touched

yesno.rule: first surface-form pair with both ids present, distinct, and single tokens (leading-space capitalized preferred); otherwise the x20 first-piece fallback

rules.p_yes: P_yes(l) = sigmoid(z_yes - z_no) on the calibrated J-lens logits at the FINAL PROMPT position (the answer position; with llava the prompt ends 'ASSISTANT:', qwen2vl carries the appended assistant header) — a binary softmax over the two resolved answer-token ids, comparable across layers and tokenizers
rules.gap: evidence gap g_l = P_yes(l) - P_yes_free(l); P_yes_free is the same question encoded through the registry's text-only chat path (NO image tokens), so g_l is how much the image itself moves the yes-belief at layer l
rules.image_free: the image-free run is a DIFFERENT sequence (no placeholder tokens), so only the answer-position distribution is compared, never intermediate positions
rules.commitment: commitment layer = smallest fitted layer where sign(P_yes(l) - 0.5) equals the model's final answer and stays there for every later fitted layer; null when the readout never stabilizes on the answer side
rules.error_auc: rank AUROC (Mann-Whitney U) predicting model ERROR, positive group = model answer != POPE label; per-layer features, both scored so 'the committed answer is not supported' ranks high: (a) 1 - answer-aligned P_yes(l), where alignment is confidence (P_yes itself for a yes answer, 1 - P_yes for a no answer); (b) -answer-aligned gap, where alignment is sign (g_l as-is for a yes answer, negated for a no answer)
rules.baseline: final-logit baselines from the model's OWN final-position logits (raw unembed, never calibrated): -|margin| and 1 - answer-aligned P_yes(final); the best of the two is the number the lens AUCs must beat

mid_band.note: workspace band ∩ fitted layers (registry.resolve_band); None when empty
